correctness.rationale: For any equal clique expansion G[K_q] and any partial deletion D, each surviving fiber remains nonempty clique; maximal independent sets project exactly to maximal independent sets of the induced base graph after deleting fully erased fibers S(D). Thus i(G[K_q]−D)=i(G−S(D)); if the base alteration threshold is t, every changing D deletes ≥q*t vertices, and equality means exactly t whole fibers, giving a bijective minimum alteration-set transfer. On a cycle C_n, i(C_n)=ceil(n/3) and deleting vertices with cyclic gap lengths a_j gives Σ ceil(a_j/3). For n=3k+1 one deletion changes i downward; n=3k+2 one deletion neutral and an altering pair requires both gaps 0 mod3; n=3k one/two deletions neutral, and altering triples must have all gaps 0 mod3 for decrease or all gaps 1 mod3 for increase. Stars-and-bars and cyclic-rotation counting yield n(k+1)/2 for n=3k+2 and k²(k+1)/2 plus k²(k−1)/2 when n=3k, sum k³. This includes k=1,C3 and q=1. Independent gap enumeration n=3..21 reproduced thresholds and all directional counts, with direct script inspected separately; universality is from fiber projection and path-gap identity.
